newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine petroleum usage up by 4.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine petroleum usage up by 4.8 pct.

text.p: Philippine petroleum products consumption rose by 4.8 percent for the first seven months of the year to 76.97 million barrels from 73.42 million the same period last year, the energy department said on Thursday.
In a report, the department said average daily petroleum consumption was at 361,000 barrels from January to July 1996 compared with 346,000 barrels in the same period in 1995.
Consumption of the power sector which rose by 5.3 percent to 25.38 million barrels from last year's 24.09 million barrels pushed up petroleum usage levels.
But usage by industries dropped slightly by 0.2 percent to 42.92 million barrels from 43.01 million barrels last year.
Fuel oil was still the most widely used fuel at 26.99 million barrels although of the oil-based products it was the only one to post a drop in consumption level.
Unleaded premium gasoline posted the biggest hike in usage level by 21.2 percent at 1.2 million barrels.
